records.title: edwardtay/awesome-ai-infrastructure
records.summary: A curated list of AI infrastructure: GPU clouds and inference servers, cluster orchestration, distributed training and compute, workflow engines, serverless and observability.

records.title: snoussimakrem/AI-Software-Engineer-Cloud-Trained-Locally-Running-Coding-Agent
records.summary: A control-center architecture where the local machine handles orchestration, monitoring, and storage management, while all LLM inference and training VRAM usage happens on free cloud GPU platforms (Kaggle/Colab).

records.title: mehtadevenn/mehtadevenn
records.summary: A production-grade, cloud-native orchestration framework for managing distributed ML training workloads across heterogeneous GPU clusters abstracting compute provisioning, experiment tracking, model versioning, and deployment pipelines into a single unified developer experience.

records.title: dstackai/dstack
records.summary: A unified orchestration layer for heterogeneous AI compute. It standardizes how to manage compute and run training and inference on GPU clouds, Kubernetes, VMs, or bare-metal clusters.

records.title: AI-Hypercomputer/xpk
records.summary: xpk (Accelerated Processing Kit, pronounced x-p-k,) is a software tool to help Cloud developers to orchestrate training jobs on accelerators such as TPUs and GPUs on GKE.

records.title: exalsius/exalsius-cli
records.summary: Command-line tool for orchestrating distributed AI training, managing ephemeral multi-cloud clusters ('colonies'), and scanning GPU prices across cloud providers. Part of the exalsius stack.

records.title: Event-Driven ML Pipeline Orchestration for Manufacturing: An AWS Industry Experience
records.summary: We present an industry experience report on three years of operating an event-driven cloud infrastructure for continuous machine learning training in automotive manufacturing. Our system orchestrates GPU-accelerated training of product-specialized model pairs, a physics prediction model and a reinforcement-learning control policy, across multiple plants, coordinating long-running GPU workloads tri

records.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
records.summary: Researchers optimized trillion-parameter MoE post-training on Ascend NPUs to achieve high efficiency, then built specialized reasoning models for operations research via curated pre-training and supervised fine-tuning.

records.title: Training Agents to Evolve with Their Harness: TaoLive Digital Avatar Agent Technical Report
records.summary: Harness-Aware Training enables compact models to adapt to evolving digital-avatar harness configurations with low latency and high accuracy.

records.title: RayOrch: Programming and Executing Lineage-Controlled Multi-Grain Dataflows for Foundation-Model Data Preparation
records.summary: RayOrch is a distributed execution engine that preserves parent-child relationships during scalable data processing, enabling efficient GPU batching and faster pipeline execution.

records.title: TurboServe: Serving Streaming Video Generation Efficiently and Economically
records.summary: TurboServe is a specialized serving system for streaming video generation that addresses session state management and dynamic resource allocation challenges through integrated scheduling, autoscaling, and migration mechanisms.

records.title: JoyNexus: Service-Oriented Multi-Tenant Post-Training for VLA Models
records.summary: JoyNexus is a multi-tenant service that enables shared-resource training, inference, and evaluation for vision-language-action models through decoupled APIs, isolated tenant slots, and group batching to improve GPU utilization.

records.title: KernelZero: Co-Evolving Proposer and Coder for Continuously Improved GPU Kernel Generation
records.summary: KernelZero is a co-evolution framework that alternately improves GPU kernel proposal and coding via capability-aligned module generation and correctness-aware reinforcement learning, achieving high pass rates on CUDA and Triton benchmarks.

records.title: Scaling Repeated-Data Pretraining: Batch Size, Regularization, and GPU-Time Tradeoffs
records.summary: Repeated-data pretraining reveals that smaller batches with implicit regularization and adjusted recipes improve validation loss, while time and GPU budgets require balancing batch size against parallelism rather than maximizing utilization.

records.title: PackServe: SLO-Aware Request Scheduling for Agentic LLM Serving at Scale
records.summary: PackServe improves agentic LLM serving efficiency by predicting interference-aware latency to pack requests onto fewer GPUs while preserving key-value cache reuse and meeting token-level latency targets.

records.title: NanoForecast v0.5: Competitive Time Series Forecasting Through Training Pipeline Optimization
records.summary: NanoForecast v0.5 is a small 6.5M-parameter time-series forecaster that achieves competitive accuracy with much larger models after fixing training pipeline errors, without altering its architecture.

records.title: MusaCoder: Native GPU Kernel Generation with Full-Stack Training on Moore Threads GPU
records.summary: MusaCoder is a full-stack training framework that generates efficient GPU kernels using reinforcement learning with execution feedback, achieving state-of-the-art performance on CUDA and MUSA backends.

records.title: GPU-Initiated Communication: Dissecting Down to the Bone
records.summary: This study analyzes GPU-initiated RDMA communication at the GPU-NIC boundary, measuring minimal transport paths and library overheads across NVIDIA platforms to reveal latency, throughput, and resource trade-offs.

records.title: Where Should Agents Live? Energy-Memory Characterization of Agentic AI for the Edge-Cloud Continuum
records.summary: Agentic-eCAL extends energy lifecycle metrics to multi-agent AI workflows, showing that inter-agent communication costs are dominated by inference overhead rather than data transport.

records.title: CUDA-Harness: Harnessing Agentic CUDA Kernel Generation and Optimization from Natural Language
records.summary: CUDA-Harness enables agentic CUDA kernel generation from natural language via structured generation, synthesis-based verification, and adaptive evolution to improve correctness and performance.

records.title: GPUAlert: A Zero-Instrumentation Process-Boundary Monitor for Diagnosing GPU Training-Job Failures
records.summary: GPUAlert is a command-line monitoring tool that provides structured notifications for training job failures with classified causes, durable logs, and output artifacts, achieving high accuracy in failure classification while maintaining minimal overhead and robust error handling.

records.title: Libra: Efficient Resource Management for Agentic RL Post-Training
records.summary: Libra improves resource management for agentic reinforcement learning by dynamically balancing GPU allocation and scheduling rollout tasks via causal feedback, boosting throughput and convergence.

records.title: SegTME-UNI2: A Foundation Model-Based Framework for Generalisable Multiclass Cell Segmentation and LLM-Driven Tumour Microenvironment Characterisation in Histopathology
records.summary: Characterising the TME from routine H&E-stained histology images requires simultaneous cell segmentation, biological feature extraction, and interpretable clinical reporting. We present SegTME-UNI2, a unified framework addressing all three requirements end-to-end: a segmentation backbone that converts raw H\&E patches into per-nucleus class labels, a structured feature-extraction pipeline that tur

records.title: LiveR: Fine-Grained Elasticity via Live Reconfiguration for Model Training
records.summary: To reduce user costs and maximize cluster utilization, large model training increasingly leverages volatile but inexpensive GPU capacity, such as spot instances and reclaimable resources in shared clusters. Yet, capitalizing on these economic benefits requires jobs to adapt within the short warning windows that many such environments provide. Existing elastic training systems still treat reconfigu

records.title: ChronoReplay: One Answer Interface Is Not Enough for Streaming Spatial Intelligence
records.summary: ChronoReplay mitigates interface lock-in in spatial vision-language models by replaying heterogeneous spatial supervision chronologically, improving cross-task transfer and enabling efficient inference-time evidence selection.

records.title: InstructSAM: Segment Any Instance with Any Instructions
records.summary: InstructSAM presents a unified framework for multi-instance segmentation using instruction-driven queries that bridge vision-language models and SAM3 through learnable instance queries and hybrid attention mechanisms.

records.title: Flattening Every Memory Peak in Long-Context Mixture-of-Experts Training
records.summary: Four scheduling techniques bound peak memory across expert dispatch, vocabulary projection, gradient checkpointing, and optimizer states to enable large-scale mixture-of-experts training at million-token contexts.

records.title: InstanceControl: Controllable Complex Image Generation without Instance Labeling
records.summary: InstanceControl enables multi-instance image generation by using vision-language models to establish instance-level correspondences between text prompts and visual conditions, while employing adaptive mask refinement for improved accuracy.

records.title: QueenVIS: Rethinking Image-Only Training for Video Instance Segmentation via Query Enrichment
records.summary: QueenVIS improves image-only video instance segmentation by enhancing object query stability through auxiliary training losses and a training-free query propagation mechanism, achieving competitive results without video-level supervision.

records.title: Keyword Harnesses Fail Open: A Cheap Diagnostic Ladder for Tool-Use Claims in Small Language Models
records.summary: A diagnostic ladder reveals false tool-use positives in small language models and shows targeted supervised fine-tuning can repair missing tool-call priors with minimal compute.

records.title: TRACE: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Safety Evaluation of Large Reasoning Models
records.summary: TRACE is a benchmark evaluating guardrail models on reasoning traces, prompts, and responses with evidence annotations, revealing greater difficulty in reasoning-trace safety detection.

records.title: Mapping CVEs to MITRE ATT&CK Techniques: A Curated Gold-Set Classifier and the Limits of LLM-Assisted Label Expansion
records.summary: A multi-label classifier maps vulnerability descriptions to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, showing that expert-curated labels improve performance while LLM-assisted labeling introduces evaluation artifacts without reliable gains.

records.title: One Click per Cell Type Suffices: Training-free Group Interaction for Cell Instance Segmentation
records.summary: Group Prompting enables efficient cell instance segmentation by leveraging per-type prompting through a training-free framework that uses multi-scale encoder features and recursive prompt expansion.

records.title: Trajectory Soup: Pushing the Compute-Scaling Frontier of LLM Mid-training via Diverse Trajectories
records.summary: Trajectory Soup distributes mid-training compute across independent branches and merges selected checkpoints to improve downstream performance beyond serial training limits.

records.title: LSREP: A Longitudinal State-Replay Protocol for Evaluating Conversational Memory, with ICE v2 as an Audited Local-First Architecture
records.summary: LSREP evaluates persistent conversational memory through replay and fidelity audits, revealing that ICE v2 trades quality for reduced context use and suffers severe multi-session failures compared to vector-RAG.

records.title: WALDO: One-Shot Exemplar-Conditioned Object Detection in Cluttered Scenes
records.summary: WALDO is a lightweight detection head that uses frozen world-model features to localize objects from a single reference image and description while detecting absence, though it does not reliably distinguish individual instance identity.

records.title: IoU-PD: IoU-Aware Privileged Distillation for Visual Grounding with Multimodal Large Language Models
records.summary: IoU-PD improves visual grounding in multimodal language models by using ground-truth boxes as privileged training guidance with geometry-aware distillation, without extra inference cost.

records.title: Pixel-Level Pavement Distress Assessment Using Instance Segmentation
records.summary: A vision-based pavement distress analysis system using Mask R-CNN instance segmentation demonstrates superior performance for crack detection and quantification compared to object detection approaches, achieving high precision and recall metrics on a custom field-collected dataset.

records.title: Exploiting Longitudinal Context in Clinician-Verified Interactive Lesion Tracking
records.summary: A verified tracking approach combines clinical registration verification with longitudinal context modeling to improve pancreatic cancer lesion segmentation, achieving superior performance in both automated and interactive settings.

records.title: jiayi-wu-3150/databricks-gpu-training-playbook
records.summary: Capability demo (not a benchmark): the full GPU lifecycle - fine-tune, eval, UC registration, batch inference, serving - running end to end on both Databricks AI Runtime serverless GPU and classic GPU, on synthetic data. The two runtimes are sized differently on purpose, so the timings are not comparable.

records.title: vini2309/OpenClaw-RL-Tutorial
records.summary: A practical OpenClaw-RL setup for training Qwen with GRPO on RunPod GPUs, including a Next.js dashboard, Pod deployment scripts, Serverless inference configuration, and Megatron compatibility patches.

records.title: dwin-gharibi/runpod-zero-shot
records.summary: Serverless GPU/CPU zero-shot text classification on RunPod. Hand the worker any text and an arbitrary list of candidate labels, get back ranked probabilities in milliseconds — no fine-tuning, no training data, no label schema baked into the model. Powered by NLI-style encoders such as BART-MNLI, DeBERTa-v3-MNLI, and multilingual checkpoints...

records.title: shivamgoel234/DataHarvest
records.summary: 🌍 Physical data marketplace where AI labs post bounties & everyday people earn money capturing real-world training data. iPhone app records video + LiDAR + IMU + ARKit 6DoF poses. Serverless GPU pipeline (ChatGPT, YOLO, MediaPipe, SAM) auto-scores submissions. Built with Next.js 16, Supabase, Modal & Swift.

records.title: arielcohen4/flex_ai_training
records.summary: Serverless LLM fine-tuning engine. Powers getflex.ai — SFT, DPO & LoRA on Modal GPUs.

records.title: hojjad3/Image-Captioning
records.summary: A SFT pipeline for Image Captioning. Combines ViT and GPT-2 using LoRA adapters for lightweight training, deployed on Modal serverless GPUs.

records.title: Closed-Loop Physics-Based Manipulation Evaluation at a Commodity Price: What 4.4 L4 GPU hours at $3.50 Buys You
records.summary: Running evaluations of contact-rich robotic manipulation at statistical scale has largely been possible only at well-resourced labs, highlighting the need for affordable and efficient options for broader audiences. We present a reproducible evaluation harness wrapper based on a previous study at 200-rollout scale on serverless commodity GPUs, at a cost of approximately $3.50 USD and 38 minutes of

records.title: LLM Fine-Tuning Workloads: Characterization, Challenges, and Opportunities for Serverless AI
records.summary: Serverless execution of Large Language Models (LLMs) is becoming important, reflecting their wide societal use. An increasingly present stage in LLM pipelines is fine-tuning, which specializes trained models and improves inference performance. Serverless operation of LLM fine-tuning workloads shifts operational concerns from the user to the provider. For these new workloads, providers face importa

records.title: ConCise: Training-Free Conclusion-Chain State Compression for Cost-Efficient Multi-Step RAG Services
records.summary: Multi-step retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has been widely deployed as LLM-powered web services for complex question answering, where iterative retrieval-reasoning rounds deliver strong multi-hop accuracy. However, this paradigm causes historical documents and reasoning traces to accumulate across rounds, inflating cumulative input tokens approximately as $O(N^2)$ with progressively increasin

records.title: LongLive-2.0: An NVFP4 Parallel Infrastructure for Long Video Generation
records.summary: LongLive-2.0 presents an NVFP4-based parallel infrastructure for long video generation that addresses training and inference bottlenecks through sequence-parallel autoregressive training and diffusion model tuning.

records.title: QwenGyre: An Elastic Reinforcement Learning Framework for Training xLong-Horizon Agents
records.summary: QwenGyre is an end-to-end framework that enables efficient online reinforcement learning for extreme-long horizon LLM agent tasks by dynamically reallocating GPUs and deduplicating redundant branching trajectories.

records.title: Rethinking Shrinkage Bias in LLM FP4 Pretraining: Geometric Origin, Systemic Impact, and UFP4 Recipe
records.summary: Uniform 4-bit training with RHT-based quantization outperforms E2M1-based methods by eliminating shrinkage bias and improving training stability across large language model architectures.

records.title: Avatar-Forever: Decoupled Parallel Training for High-Quality Real-Time Infinite Avatars
records.summary: Avatar-Forever uses parallel training branches and chunk-wise caching to enable efficient, robust, real-time infinite interactive avatar generation.

records.title: Pre-Compiled Pipeline Shards for Distributed LLM Inference on Intel AI PC Fleets
records.summary: Multiple AI PCs collaborate via pipeline-parallel layer sharding and speculative decoding to serve large language models faster than single-node inference.

records.title: Architecting for Hardware Diversity: Meta's End-to-End Co-Design for High-Performance AI Training on AMD GPUs
records.summary: Optimizing AMD accelerators for large-scale recommendation model training via hardware-model co-design, analytical performance modeling, and agentic porting workflows achieves up to 1.5x throughput gains over direct CUDA ports.
